subject.title: fix(edit): show candidate lines with similarity scores on oldText match failure

question: Should maintainers use this PR as the canonical edit oldText mismatch diagnostic, prefer another open candidate, or consolidate the competing branches first?
rationale: The code path is appropriate and the patch has no blocking finding, but several open PRs implement competing user-facing error formats for the same canonical issue.

options.title: Use This PR As Canonical
options.body: Land this branch after CI is clean if the expected/found/hint format is the output maintainers want, then close or rebase the other candidates.

options.title: Prefer Another Candidate
options.body: Select a richer open candidate such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97269 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97512 if its output shape better matches the requested diagnostic.

options.title: Consolidate First
options.body: Pause this PR and port the best bounded-scoring and formatting pieces into one maintainer-owned branch before landing.

recommendation.title: Use This PR As Canonical
recommendation.body: Land this branch after CI is clean if the expected/found/hint format is the output maintainers want, then close or rebase the other candidates.
